prompt:
Create the PLAYER PORTRAIT for a boss-intro card in the video game Enter the Gungeon, in exactly the art style of the first attached image (the Pilot's portrait at the bottom-left of the Beholster boss card): high-resolution pixel art at card resolution, a bold thick dark-brown outline around the whole figure, crisp hard-edged pixels, cel shading with 3-4 tones per material, a warm top-left light, no gradients, no blur, no anti-aliasing, no texture noise.

SUBJECT: Pluto. Copy the cat in the SECOND attached image exactly (same face, markings, colours, pixel rendering, outline and shading), and check his markings against the attached photos of the real cat. A chubby adult cat with GREY-BROWN taupe tabby fur (cool taupe brown with near-black mackerel stripes, NOT orange, NOT ginger), a forehead "M" marking, a white blaze between the eyes running down to a white muzzle, a white chest and white paws, a small white oval spot on top of his head between the ears surrounded by tabby, big ears with pink inner ears, hazel-green eyes with vertical slit pupils, a pink nose.

POSE: a heroic head-and-shoulders bust in three-quarter view, facing RIGHT toward the boss, smug confident expression like the Pilot's. One white front paw holds his weapon CLOSE TO HIS CHEST, like the Pilot holds his pistol up beside his face: a small white-and-silver ROYAL CANIN dry cat food pouch held sideways like a gun, red band with a five-dot crown, a purple round label with a grey cat, the torn-open zip top pointing up and to the right with a few brown kibble just above it. The chest and shoulders are cut off by the bottom edge of the image and the left shoulder by the left edge, exactly like the Pilot's bust.

COMPOSITION (strict): 16:9 frame. EVERYTHING - head, ears, paw, pouch and kibble - stays inside the LEFT 42% of the frame width and inside the lower 62% of the frame height. The right 58% of the frame and the whole top 38% are completely empty. The head is large: it fills about two thirds of that left area's width. Background: one flat solid chroma green (#00B140) everywhere, no scenery, no shadows on the background, no text.
